accuracy_notes: Current WRMP guidance updated 16 June 2026 was treated as strategic planning evidence, not a parcel connection or spare-capacity certificate.
National Framework 2025 scenario totals were retained at national/regional scale and were not downscaled to parcel deficits.
Water-stress 2021 determination was kept date- and purpose-exact and was not relabelled as a 2026 parcel water-availability result.
Statutory DWMP risk, planning horizons and reporting thresholds were retained at company/catchment scale and not converted to parcel sewer capacity.
Flood zones, climate-change allowances and modelling evidence were kept as screening/scenario evidence; no flood depth, permission or Future Growth score was inferred.
Planning Data flood-zone examples were retained as research-only examples with model/event type distinctions preserved.
Ofwat PR24 expenditure and performance commitments were kept at regulatory/company level and not converted into local infrastructure delivery.
No parcel relation, Future Growth score, business row or water/sewer capacity value was fabricated.
